description: Post hoc provenance review (2026-10-09) of the R1–R2 search records: numbered list of the algorithms and constructions found in them (sec. 1, items 1–12, each with code location, record values and literature status), three additional findings (notes 1–3), lineage narrative (sec. 2), transfer ideas (sec. 3) and record list (sec. 4). Summarised per node in figS3A_lineage.tsv (evidence_locator, evidence_summary).

Post hoc provenance review (2026-10-09) of the R3–R4 search records: two key facts on library use (key facts 1–2), library modules and their use in R3–R4 (sec. 1), lineages and classical constructions rediscovered from scratch (sec. 2), transfer ideas for cytometry panels (secs. 3–4) and record list (sec. 5). Summarised per node in figS3A_lineage.tsv (evidence_locator, evidence_summary).

Post hoc review (2026-10-09) of the covering-design structure of the designs used in WitnessFlow: three main findings (main findings, items 1–3), balance (sec. 1), backbone as derived design (sec. 2), illustrative numbers (sec. 3) and small demonstration experiments (sec. 4, items 5A–5F). Summarised per node in figS3A_lineage.tsv (evidence_locator, evidence_summary).

Independent crosscheck table: numpy re-verification of 45 saved coverings (the 44 improved cells and C(33,20,5)), with claimed and counted blocks, uncovered t-subsets and the recorded origin of each value (column sources).

WitnessFlow code cited by two nodes: wfgeom.py (ROSE_BASE, rose_orbits(): the 130 blocks of C(26,6,3) as 5 cyclic orbits of 26 shifts) and e5e.py (module docstring, method breakout: the weighted local search of the two-fold covering search, panel d).
